_help: Word Builder data. Each theme has a group (shown as a heading), a name, a picture, and words. Each word has: word, syllables (from Merriam-Webster, with · between syllables), pos (part of speech), definition (plain English, based on Merriam-Webster), picture (an emoji, or a file like images/bus.jpg), sentence (a short example), and abstract (true for words with no clear picture; games ask about their meaning instead). To add a word, copy one line, change it, and keep the commas between lines.
